## Project Overview

Wellness Ranch Equine Assisted Therapy is the focus of my graduate Culminating Experience Project at Cal Poly Pomona.

The project involves evaluating website performance, digital marketing effectiveness, and opportunities to improve online engagement.

## My Contributions

- Developed and validated GA4 tracking.
- Examined website engagement and acquisition channels.
- Evaluated lead-generation measurement.
- Identified SEO and website content opportunities.
- Supported recommendations for improving marketing performance.

## Tools and Skills

Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Assistant, GA4 DebugView, SEO, and Marketing Analytics.
